description: First flight 25/10/1956. Served with 2 Squadron in Vietnam from Phan Rang from 07/1969 as part of the USAF 35th Tactical Fighter Wing, and was later modified for cartographic survey. Sold in 1985 and resold to the Willowbank Caravan Park in 1986; displayed on a pylon beside the Cunningham Highway and suffering from weather, nesting birds and vandalism. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.
Located in the paddock adjoining A84-238 at Willowbank. Its rear fuselage was fitted to A84-230, now at Bull Creek in Western Australia. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.
